title: 1997 Topps #239 Jermaine Dye All-Star Rookie Cup Atlanta Braves Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
1997 Topps #239 Jermaine Dye, Atlanta Braves - Topps All-Star Rookie trophy card. Back notes he homered in his first major league plate appearance (May 17, 1996).

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
